fields.quoted_span: a class of Philadelphia tenants allege that Willow Bridge subscribed to and used RealPage services in violation of Philadelphia Code § 9-813.
fields.note: The litigation allegations and the remedies are supported. The claim that § 9-813 restricts landlords' use of algorithmic rent-coordination or revenue-management services is only loosely supported. The document gives no description of the ordinance's prohibited conduct, and the rule itself admits this. The only support is the general statement that such ordinances restrict algorithmic rent-setting.

fields.quoted_span: Philadelphia’s ordinance permits an aggrieved person to elect statutory damages of $2,000 per violation or treble actual damages, together with equitable relief, interest and attorney fees and costs.
